name: Netting Cut Off Reference Data Report V 02
definition: The Netting Cut Off Reference Data Report message is sent to a participant by a central system to provide details of scheduled, changed, existing and previous netting cut off data held at a central system.

ReportData.name: Report Data
ReportData.definition: Specifies the meta data for the netting cut off report including message pagination.

ParticipantNettingCutOffData.name: Participant Netting Cut Off Data
ParticipantNettingCutOffData.definition: Provides the latest information related to the status of a netting cut off held at a central system.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
